name: Evafresh Antiseptic Disinfectant Liquid
tagline: Everyday hygiene for home and work
shortDescription: Antiseptic disinfectant liquid for floors, surfaces and laundry rinses.
description: Evafresh Antiseptic Disinfectant Liquid adds an extra hygiene step to your cleaning routine: dilute it for floors, bathrooms and surfaces, or add it to your laundry rinse. Available from 1L for homes up to 25L for schools, hotels and offices.
ingredients: [PLACEHOLDER] Add the active ingredient(s) and concentration exactly as printed on your label.
howToUse: Always dilute before use, following the label.
Floors and surfaces: add to water, wipe or mop.
Laundry: add to the final rinse.
safety: Keep out of reach of children. Always dilute. Avoid contact with eyes. Do not swallow. Do not mix with other cleaning products.
